column4: CREATE USER 'john'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'password'; — i-create ang user account
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON mydb.* TO 'john'@'localhost'; — i-grant ang specific privileges
REVOKE INSERT ON mydb.* FROM 'john'@'localhost'; — i-remove ang privilege
SELECT User, Host FROM mysql.user; — ipapakita ang lahat ng users
ALTER USER 'john'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'newpassword'; — i-update ang password
